message: cross_wishart() needs at least 2 degrees of freedom per row and row 1 has 1. One complex draw gives a rank-one matrix whose coherence is exactly 1 whatever the signals did; use more segments, more tapers, or a wider smooth.
the cross-spectral matrix in row 3 is not positive definite: its determinant is -0.07627. A coherence of 1 to machine precision does this, and so does assembling the four columns in the wrong order.
the response of cross_wishart() is an auto-spectrum and must be positive and finite in every row.
the second auto-spectrum, vreal1, must be positive and finite in every row.

cross_wishart: the density needs `vreal1`, `vreal2`, `vreal3`, which nothing on this response supplies. Write the addition term: w11 | vreal(<column>) + vreal(..., <column>) + vreal(..., ..., <column>) ~ ...
cross_wishart: the density needs `vint1`, which nothing on this response supplies. Write the addition term: w11 | vint(<column>) ~ ...

cens()/trunc() need a family with a CDF (currently: gaussian, lognormal, poisson, exponential, weibull, inverse.gaussian, cox). The list is not closed: a family supplies one through the lcdf argument of frmtmb_family(), and a family that only ever sees RIGHT censoring may supply the log survivor fun
